question.prompt: Select all statements supported by the library records.

options.text: Longer hours were the sole cause of the increase.
Student borrowers were not identified separately.

solution.ru: Выдач стало больше, но записи не различали группы читателей. Срок обучения изменился одновременно с часами работы, поэтому причину роста установить нельзя.
solution.en: Loans increased, and the records did not separate borrower groups. The school term and opening hours changed together, so the cause cannot be isolated.

text.ru: Автор прямо отвергает вывод об одной причине.
text.en: The author explicitly rejects attributing the change to one cause.

sentences.text: A town library recorded more loans in September after extending its Saturday opening hours.
The local school term also began that month.
The records did not distinguish student borrowers from other borrowers.
The increase therefore cannot be attributed solely to the longer opening hours.

question.prompt: By what percent did daily orders increase from day 1 to day 4?

solution.ru: Заказов стало на 18 − 6 = 12 больше. Относительно исходных 6 это 12 / 6 × 100% = 200%.
solution.en: Orders increased by 18 − 6 = 12. Relative to the original 6, this is 12 / 6 × 100% = 200%.

text.ru: Сравнили разность с другим основанием. Основание здесь — 6.
text.en: The base for the percent increase is the original value, 6.

text.ru: При росте на 100% было бы 12 заказов.
text.en: An increase of 100% would give 12 orders.
An increase of 150% would give 15 orders.
18 is 300% of 6, but the increase is 200%.
